basis:
Independent arithmetic: 65 × 10 = 650 g/day; 65 × 12 = 780 g/day; 36/24 = 1.5; 650 × 1.5 = 975 g; 780 × 1.5 = 1,170 g. 120 > 90, so loading is indicated.

Steps: ["Daily lower bound = round(65 × 10) = 650 g/day; daily upper bound = round(65 × 12) = 780 g/day.", "A 36-hour window is 36/24 = 1.5 days.", "Window total lower = round(650 × 1.5) = 975 g; window total upper = round(780 × 1.5) = 1,170 g.", "Indicated = 120 minutes > 90 minutes, so true."]
Notes: A non-integer window fraction (1.5 days) checks the window-total arithmetic: totals scale by window hours / 24 rather than by whole days. The 36-hour edge of the planning band is a range, not a precise start hour.
